data.name: SCENE_D09P03_001
data.value: Urggggh!

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_002
data.value: I'm not done![pause=10] I'm not finished yet!

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_003
data.value: ..................[pause=15] Do you say that sincerely?

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_007
data.value: Aiyiyiyi!

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_009
data.value: I trust that you aren't lying.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_010
data.value: You may pass.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_011
data.value: Get through Mt. Blaze.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_012
data.value: And...[pause=10] Promise me this.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_013
data.value: Promise me that you will[wait=5] find the cause of the calamities[wait=5] that wrack our world...

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_014
data.value: And stop the disasters[wait=5] from sowing more destruction[wait=5] and suffering.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_015
data.value: ............[pause=15] I will hold you to that promise.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_016
data.value: You've made me believe[wait=5] that you will honor that promise.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_017
data.value: If you do not forget...[pause=10] the courage you showed in facing me.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_018
data.value: Waaaah![pause=10] Is...is there anything else?

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_019
data.value: No.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_020
data.value: I was only preparing to[wait=5] take off.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_021
data.value: Oh...[pause=10] (Does it need to do that?)

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_022
data.value: Farewell!

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_023
data.value: Whew...

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_024
data.value: (Mt. Blaze...[pause=10] it lets us pass.)

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_025
data.value: (A promise.[pause=10] Find the cause of the calamities.)

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_026
data.value: (That's what we're already looking for,[pause=10] {NAME_1}.)

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_027
data.value: Come on.[pause=15] Let's keep going.

data.name: SCENE_D09P03_028
data.value: Next...[pause=10] the cold.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_001
data.value: No![pause=10] I cannot allow your passage!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_002
data.value: The frigid forest's air...

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_003
data.value: It has warmed considerably,[wait=5] in recent times.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_004
data.value: The flow of frigid air[wait=5] has been disturbed in the forest.[pause=10] Snow has started to melt.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_005
data.value: Snow is melting.[pause=10] Snow that has never melted before.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_006
data.value: This has never happened,[pause=10] not even once.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_007
data.value: Then you appeared in the forest.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_008
data.value: Is this not your doing?!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_009
data.value: Is that all?[pause=10] You expect me to believe that?!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_010
data.value: Waaaaaaaah!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_011
data.value: Enough of your foolish talk![pause=10] Prepare for your end!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_012
data.value: Stop it!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_013
data.value: A-Absol!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_014
data.value: There is nothing false in what they said.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_015
data.value: Calamities are indeed occurring[wait=5] everywhere in nature.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_016
data.value: Is...[pause=10] Is that true?

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_017
data.value: Yes.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_018
data.value: I have the ability to sense natural disasters.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_019
data.value: The calamities taking place now[wait=5] are of a special nature.[pause=10] I've never experienced such before.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_020
data.value: ............[pause=15] So, there are calamities besides this...

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_021
data.value: ..................[pause=15] Fine.[pause=10] I will choose to believe you.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_022
data.value: You may pass.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_023
data.value: {NAME_2}!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_024
data.value: However!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_025
data.value: Waah!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_026
data.value: You must try to prevent[wait=5] the calamities from spreading.

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_027
data.value: I'm counting on you!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_028
data.value: Yup![pause=10] We promise,[pause=10] {NAME_2}!

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_029
data.value: Whew...[pause=10] That was too close...

data.name: SCENE_D10P03_030
data.value: Thank you.[pause=10] You saved us.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_001
data.value: (The peak of Mt. Freeze...[pause=10] This is the place.)

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_002
data.value: (A presence...[pause=10] ancient.)

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_003
data.value: I awaited you.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_004
data.value: Thirty years ago,[pause=10] two fugitives came here seeking[wait=5] the truth about a curse.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_005
data.value: That curse...[pause=10] it was never theirs.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_006
data.value: Their humanity was never the cause of the disasters.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_007
data.value: They carried what the world refused to see:[pause=10] a will to save, against all odds.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_008
data.value: And you,[pause=10] their heirs,[pause=10] you bear the same accusation.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_009
data.value: But the truth does not change with rumors.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_010
data.value: The calamities are not your doing.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_011
data.value: They are the sign of a far older,[pause=10] far deeper imbalance.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_012
data.value: Look beneath the surface of the world.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_013
data.value: What is believed to protect[wait=5] might be the prison of something immense.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_014
data.value: Beware,[pause=10] heirs.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_015
data.value: The road ahead[wait=5] leads to the heart of the earth[wait=5] and the summit of the sky.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_016
data.value: Ninetales...[pause=10] thank you.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_017
data.value: Carry my testimony.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_018
data.value: A truth kept too long[wait=5] becomes the weapon of those who lie.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_019
data.value: Go,[pause=10] now.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_020
data.value: And remember:[pause=10] you are not fugitives.

data.name: SCENE_D11P03_021
data.value: You are witnesses.

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_001
data.value: Look![pause=10] It's {NAME_3}![pause=10] {NAME_4} and {NAME_5} too!

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_002
data.value: Urrgggh!

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_003
data.value: Did you do it?[pause=10] {NAME_2}?

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_004
data.value: Yes, fine.

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_005
data.value: We will be fine.[pause=10] But we must get out immediately.

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_006
data.value: What about {NAME_2}?[pause=10] Will it be OK?

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_007
data.value: Your concern is unneeded.[pause=10] It will awaken soon enough.

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_008
data.value: It had lost control[wait=5] only because it was enraged[wait=5] from having its sleep disturbed.

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_009
data.value: It should calm down.

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_010
data.value: Waah...[pause=10] Another quake!

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_011
data.value: Out![pause=5] Quickly!

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_012
data.value: (The heart of the earth...[pause=10] it awakens.)

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_013
data.value: (We must calm it.[pause=10] For those who accuse us.[pause=10] For ourselves.)

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_014
data.value: Get ready, {NAME_1}.

data.name: SCENE_D12P04_015
data.value: It rises.

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_001
data.value: (The summit.[pause=10] The clouds.[pause=10] He is here.)

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_002
data.value: You are those who climbed my tower.

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_003
data.value: I remember two beings who came to ask the sky[wait=5] to save a world that rejected them.

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_004
data.value: You ask the same thing,[pause=10] thirty years later.

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_005
data.value: Show that this world still deserves your choice.

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_006
data.value: I am ready.

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_007
data.value: Let the sky judge.

data.name: SCENE_D13P03_008
data.value: Let's go, {NAME_0}!
